environment.description: Node.js Apollo GraphQL server running in a Docker container on ECS Fargate with task role attached. Container runs with default capabilities. VPC has unrestricted egress. IMDSv1 enabled on the underlying infrastructure. No network policy restricting outbound traffic from the container.

config.task_role: arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/app-task-role with S3 and DynamoDB access
